lessons.mistake: ExceptionStream registers and textual Context stack were initially at risk of being combined across different thread IDs.
lessons.rule: Keep each register and stack source in a thread ledger and forbid cross-thread register synthesis.

lessons.mistake: A volatile post-call register can be mistaken for the allocator argument.
lessons.rule: Recover the call argument from the saved stack slot at the call boundary and verify the arithmetic in the exact listing.

lessons.mistake: A six-row exact family control did not classify the other materialized incidents in the same case tree.
lessons.rule: Classify the full materialized census; use excluded for other sinks instead of merging them into the family.
enforcement: family-membership.json contains 65 decisions: 6 confirmed, 13 context_only, 46 excluded, zero unknown

lessons.mistake: A historical report in the old-version folder was counted as a crash TXT pseudo-incident.
lessons.rule: Apply dump recognition to every family-path candidate before parsing or counting.

lessons.mistake: A derived old report set remained permanently inside the raw old-version family folder after its useful findings had been integrated.
lessons.rule: Keep one canonical report set. Nested old derived reports are temporary: attest semantic transfer against exact hashes, delete TXT/HTML/extra HTML/evidence/ZIP, and preserve raw TXT/DMP/saves.

lessons.mistake: A shared local allocator-failure mechanism could be mistaken for the same exact crash family despite different sink instructions and exception classes.
lessons.rule: Classify a different sink with the same local mechanism as context_only unless same sink and defect identity are proven; never increase the exact-family counter from context alone.
